spans.s: हस् vt. or vi. 1P (pp. हसित; pres. हसति) 1. To laugh, to smile, परिघोरुभुजानाह हसन्ती स्वागतं कपीन् Bt.vii.63, xiv.93; 2. to open, to blow, e.g. हसिष्यति पद्मजालम्; 3. to joke, Kir.xiii.47; 4. to resemble, e.g. श्रिया हसद्भिः कमलानि सस्मितैः Kir.viii.44; 5. to brighten up; 6. to laugh at, to ridicule.With अप-, to deride, to ridicule.With अव-, to laugh at, to deride, स्थितावहस्येव पुरं मघोनः Bt.i.6.With उप-, to laugh at, to deride, कुटज किं कुसुमैरुपहस्यते
Ghat.17
.With परि-, 1. to laugh at, to deride, जनानामानंदः परिहसति निर्वाणपदवीम् G.

; 2. to joke.With प्र-, 1. to laugh, to smile, ततः प्रहस्यापभयः पुरंदरम् R.iii.51; 2. to mock, to deride, to ridicule, e.g. हसंतं प्रहसंत्येताः.With वि-, 1. to laugh gently, to smile, किंचिद्विहस्यार्थपतिं बभाषे R.ii.46; 2. to laugh at, to ridicule, गौरीवक्त्रभृकुटिरचनां या विहस्येव फेनैः Megh.i.50, किमिति विषादसि रोदिषि विकला विहसति युवतिसभा तव सकला Git.G.ix.
हस m. 1. Laughter; 2. mirth, merriment, joy; 3. derision.

हास m. 1. Laughing, laughter, Rt.iii.26; 2. joy, merriment; 3. one of the eight sentiments in poetry (thus defined in the S.D.- विकृताकारवाग्वेशचेष्टादेः कुहुकाद्भवेत् । हासो हास्यस्थायिभावः श्वेतः प्रथमदैवतः); 4. derision, R.xii.36; 5. blowing, opening, तेनुः सरोजलक्ष्मीं स्थलपद्महासैः Bt.ii.3.
हसन n. the act of laughing, laughter.
हसनी f. A portable fireplace.
हसंती f. 1. A portable fireplace; 2. a kind of mallikā.
हसित n. 1. Laughter; 2. jesting; 3. the bow of the god of love.

हस्त m. 1. The hand, M.iii.214, 216, Megh.ii.12, 33; 2. possession (fig.), M.viii.340; 3. signature, handwriting, स्वहस्तकालसंपन्नं शासनं कारयेत् स्थिरः Yaj.i.320, or धार्यतामयं प्रियायाः स्वहस्तः Vikr.ii.; 4. a measure of length from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger (equal to about 18 inches); 5. an elephant’s trunk, नागेंद्रहस्तास्त्वचि कर्कशत्वात् K.S.i.36; 6. the thirteenth lunar asterism consisting of five stars; 7. abundance, mass; (in this sense it is used only at the end of compounds and implies excellence), e.g. रतिविगलितबंधे केशवहस्ते सुकेश्याः सतिकुसुमसनाथे किं करात्येषे बर्हः Vikr.iv.(हस्तेकृ ‘to take in hand, to take possession of, to make one’s own, to take by the hand’; in this phrase, हस्ते is considered as a prefix or not; hence हस्तेकृत्य or हस्ते कृत्वा.)
हस्ता f. The thirteenth lunar asterism.
हस्त-अक्षर n. one’s own sign manual, signature, handwriting.
हस्त-अग्र n. the extremity of the hand, the fingers.
हस्त-अंगुलि f. any finger of the hand.
हस्त-आमलक n. the fruit of the myrobalan held in the hand (lit.); anything clearly seen or understood (fig.).
हस्त-आवाप m. a finger-guard used by archers.
हस्तेकरण n. marriage.
हस्त-कमल n. a lotus-like hand.
हस्त-कौशल n. manual dexterity.
हस्त-क्रिया f. any manual performance.
हस्त-गत a. fallen into one’s possession, gained, obtained, secured, त्वं पार्थ्यसे हस्तगता ममैभिः R.vii.67.
हस्त-चापल्य n. manual dexterity.
हस्त-तल n. 1. the palm of the hand; 2. the tip of an elephant’s trunk.
हस्त-ताल m. clappling the hands together.
हस्त-दोष m. a slip of the hand.
हस्त-धारण, -वारण n. warding off a blow.
हस्त-धारण, -वारण n. warding off a blow.
हस्त-पाद n. (sing.) hands and feet, Sak.iv.
हस्त-पृष्ठ n. the back of the hand.
हस्त-प्राप्य a. in obtainable by the hand, reached with the hand, हस्तप्राप्यस्तबकनमितो बालमंदारवृक्षः Megh.ii.12.
हस्त-मणि m. a jewel worn on the wrist.
हस्त-लाघव n. manual readiness, legerdemain.
हस्त-वत् a. dexterous, clever.
हस्त-संवाहन n. rubbing with the hands, मम समुचितो हस्तसंवाहनानाम् Megh.ii.33.
हस्त-सिद्धि f. 1. manual labour; 2. hire, wages.
हस्त-सूत्र n. a bracelet worn on the wrist, K.S.vii.25.
हस्ताहस्ति ind. hand to hand.
हस्तिक n. A multitude of elephants.
हास्तिक (I) m. An elephant-driver.
हास्तिक (II) n. A herd of elephants.
हस्तिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having hands; 2. having trunk.
हस्तिन् (II) m. An elephant, M.iv.120, iii.162; (four kinds of elephants are enumerated, viz., भद्र, मंद्र, मृग and मिश्र).
हस्तिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having hands; 2. having trunk.

हस्तिनी f. 1. A female elephant; 2. a kind of perfume; 3. a woman of a particular class; (she is described as having thick lips, thick hips, thick fingers, large breasts, and libidinous appetite, स्थूलाधरा स्थूलनितंबबिंबा स्थूलांगुलिझ् स्थूलकुचा सुशीला । कामोत्सुका गाढरतिप्रिया च नितंबखर्वा खलु हस्तिनी स्यात् Ratimanjarī). See चित्रिणी, पद्मिनी and शंखिणी.
हस्तिन्-अध्यक्ष m. a superintendent of elephants.
हस्तिन्-आयुर्वेद m. a work treating of elephant’s diseases.
हस्तिन्-आरोह m. an elephant-rider.
हस्तिन्-कक्ष्य m. 1. a lion; 2. a tiger.
हस्तिन्-कर्ण m. the castor-oil plant.
हस्तिन्-चारिन् m. an elephant-driver.
हस्तिन्-दंत (I) m. 1. a peg projecting from a wall; 2. the tusk of an elephant.
हस्तिन्-दंत (II) n. 1. ivory; 2. a radish.
हस्तिन्-नख n. a sort of turret protecting the access to the gate of a city or fort.
हस्तिन्-प, -पक m. an elephant-driver, e.g.
इति घोषयतीव
डिंडिमः करिणो हस्तिपकाहतः क्वणन्.
हस्तिन्-प, -पक m. an elephant-driver, e.g.
इति घोषयतीव
डिंडिमः करिणो हस्तिपकाहतः क्वणन्.
हस्तिन्-मद m. the exudation from an elephant’s temples.
हस्तिन्-मल्ल m. 1. a name of Airāvata; 2. of Gaṇeśa; 3. a heap of ashes; 4. a shower of dust; 5. frost.
हस्तिन्-यूथ m. a herd of elephants.
हस्तिन्-वर्चस n. the magnificence of an elephant.
हस्तिन्-वाह m. 1. an elephant-driver; 2. a hook for driving elephants.

हस्तिन्-स्नान n. the bathing of an elephant; (it is figuratively used to indicate any useless occupation, from the elephant’s throwing dirt over his body in the very act of bathing, अवशेंद्रियचित्तानां हस्तिस्नानमिव क्रिया Hit.i.).
हस्तिन्-हस्त m. an elephant’s trunk.
हस्तिन(ना)पुर n. Name of a city founded by king Hastina. It forms the central scene of action in the Mahābhārata. (It is also called गजाह्वय, नागसाह्वय, नागह्व, हस्तिन.)
हस्तिन(ना)पुर n. Name of a city founded by king Hastina. It forms the central scene of action in the Mahābhārata. (It is also called गजाह्वय, नागसाह्वय, नागह्व, हस्तिन.)
हस्त्य a. (f. स्त्या) 1. Given with the hand; 2. done with the hand, manual.
हस्त्य a. (f. स्त्या) 1. Given with the hand; 2. done with the hand, manual.
हासिका f. 1. Laughter; 2. mirth.
हास्य (I) a. (f. स्या) Laughable, ridiculous, R.ii.43.
हास्य (II) n. 1. Laughter, Yaj.i.84; 2. mirth, amusement, M.ix.227; 3. ridicule, derision.
हास्य (I) a. (f. स्या) Laughable, ridiculous, R.ii.43.
हास्य-आस्पद n. a laughing-stock, a butt.
हास्य-पदवी f. ridicule, laughter (used with या, गम् &c.).
हास्य-रस m. the sentiment of humour. (See हास 3.)
हास्तिन n. A name of Hastināpura.
